# Interview P1
Participant: P1
Role: Staff engineer
Date: 2026-09-08
Segment: Agent power user
Method: interview

Q: Walk me through how you start a task with an agent.
P1: Every new chat, I paste the same architecture notes.
P1: It takes ten minutes before the agent knows what our services are called.
Q: What happens when the agent is done?
P1: Big diffs from an agent — I just skim and hope.
P1: I'd rather review twenty small changes than one giant one.
Q: When do you trust its output?
P1: When I can watch it work step by step, I trust it a lot more.
P1: The worst is when it silently rewrites a file I didn't ask about.
Q: Anything else?
P1: Honestly the tooling is fine, it's the handoff that hurts.
